name: 墨珠落字
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: Windows desktop app icon concept, centered square 1024x1024 raster reference. Product promise: spoken ideas gently become clear writing. Style: clean flat vector-like geometry, no photographic texture, no 3D mockup. Palette: ink #282c27, warm paper #f1f4eb, muted ink #676b63, restrained sage #dfe3d7. Composition: warm-paper square field, centered compact dark emblem, generous 20% padding, strong legibility at 20–48 pixels. No text, no letters, no watermark, no app-store badge, no device frame, no microphone, no bright colors, no tiny detail. Subject: A horizontal group of five dark ink beads: one large central round bead, two smaller tapered oval beads on each side, with the side beads always lower in height than the center. Beneath them is one short softly rounded ink baseline, suggesting spoken thought settling into written words. The silhouette is calm, symmetric and compact.
rationale: 与 HUD 节奏最直接；底部短笔划传达落字。风险是珠子过小或底线像播放暂停。
